title: Move-loop instruction
statement: Given source and destination registers, an exit state, a function assigning a state to each of three phases, and a phase $j$, the instruction is: test whether the source is zero, branching to the exit state if so and otherwise to phase $1$ when $j=0$; decrement the source and go to phase $2$ when $j=1$; or increment the destination and go to phase $0$ when $j=2$.
hypotheses_covered: source and destination registers in the seven-register set
a function from the three phases to states
a phase in the three-element set
